name: Adiel
overview: Adiel is a male member of the tribe of Levi, uniquely identified as the son of Jahzerah according to 1 Chronicles 9:12. There are no additional notes that expand on his life or role, making his mention primarily genealogical within the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name Adiel means 'adornment of God [El],' reflecting a theologically rich meaning that emphasizes being a precious or honorable gift from God. This proper name, recorded in 1 Chronicles 9:12, is not indicated as being given directly by God but carries significant spiritual connotation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Adiel as the son of Jahzerah (1 Chronicles 9:12). It is also inferred that he is the father of Maasai (1 Chronicles 9:12) and the son of Azmaveth (1 Chronicles 27:25), indicating his placement within a Levitical genealogical line.
scriptureSignificance: Adiel's significance lies in his role within the Levitical lineage, which was critical for the priestly and temple service in Israel. His mention in the genealogies underscores the continuity of God's chosen priestly tribe and highlights the faithfulness of God's covenant people through successive generations. While not prominent in narrative events, his presence in the biblical record affirms the importance of preserving the heritage and identity of the tribe of Levi.
